newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daikyo bid-only after new president report.
newsitem.headline: Daikyo bid-only after new president report.

text.p: Daikyo Inc's shares were bid-only in Friday afternoon trade, following reports that it will appoint a new president from Sanwa Bank Ltd's non-bank unit, brokers said.
As of 0503 GMT, the shares of the large condominium builder were bid-only at 430 yen, after closing at 413 yen on Thursday.

A wire service affiliated with the Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Friday that Masaharu Hasegawa, president of Sanwa Bank Ltd's finance unit Sanwa Business Credit Co Ltd, would become the new president.
He will replace Shuji Yokoyama at the helm of the troubled Daikyo, which has accumulated massive debt in the wake of plunging land prices in the post "bubble economy" years, it said.
